title: BTS (Bangtan Sonyeondan)
description: Global pop icons who broke worldwide stadium records with self-produced anthems championing youth identity and mental health awareness.

title: Stray Kids
description: Self-producing powerhouse 3RACHA and 8 members delivering explosive electronic beats, deep sub-bass rap, and relentless kinetic choreography.

title: SEVENTEEN
description: The synchronized masters of K-Pop divided into Vocal, Hip-Hop, and Performance units, orchestrating stadium-filling choreographies and self-made hits.

title: TXT (Tomorrow X Together)
description: Storytellers blending pop-punk energy, dream-pop synths, and intricate narrative universe lore following adolescent growing pains.

title: ATEEZ
description: Pirate-concept performance titans who conquered international festival stages including Coachella with hard-hitting theatrical stagecraft.

title: BLACKPINK
description: The highest-charting female Korean act, headlining Coachella and British Summer Time with stadium anthems and fashion house ambassadorships.

title: TWICE
description: Nine-member juggernaut renowned for irresistible pop hooks, radiant energy, and groundbreaking North American stadium tour achievements.

title: NewJeans
description: Trailblazers who disrupted the industry with effortless Cyber-Y2K aesthetics, UK garage grooves, and nostalgic Jersey club rhythms.

title: aespa
description: Futuristic cyberpunk concept pioneers operating alongside digital avatar counterparts ae-members across the metaphysical KWANGYA dimension.

title: LE SSERAFIM
description: Fearless five-member act championing confidence, athleticism, and genre-bending Afrobeat, pop, and rock tracks.

title: IVE
description: Chart-topping sensation delivering elegant, self-confident disco-pop and baroque earworms like Love Dive and I AM.

title: (G)I-DLE
description: Self-producing girl group led by Soyeon, acclaimed for provocative social commentary, rock instrumentation, and bold concept reinventions.
